ns2:course.label: Perf Pract Student Works II
ns2:course.description: Performance laboratory involving the rehearsal and performance of student works under faculty supervision. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
